headline: Clinton order extends the life of a federal advisory committee on expanding training opportunities.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13111, to extend the Advisory Committee on Expanding Training Opportunities. That means the committee can keep meeting and giving advice for a longer period. Only the title was provided, so the new end date and any other changes are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Committee on Expanding Training Opportunities
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and advising the government for a longer period.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 12, 2001; the exact new end date for the committee is not given in the source material.
